verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. The only hint is the 'api-reference/v1/' path in one docs URL, but that item's content is about user attribution, not versioning, and nothing describes version lifecycles, deprecation notices, or sunset timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
